account_name.description: The name on the account, as the bank holds it.

account_number_last4.description: The account number's last four characters. The full number is never in a list or a record: revealPayeeBankAccount shows it, after step-up, and the reveal is audited (SEC-11).

bank_country.description: The bank's country, ISO 3166 two-letter code.

kind.description: singapore: a Singapore bank's account, paid by FAST or GIRO; overseas: a bank's account outside Singapore, paid by telegraphic transfer.

number_kind.description: Whether the number is an IBAN.
